description: This PHP class defines the TotalDurationModel used in the OrangeHRM Time Plugin API. It models total duration data, providing a method to convert a duration in seconds into an array with hours, minutes, and a formatted label.

classes.name: TotalDurationModel
classes.description: A model representing total duration, providing detailed time components and formatted label.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TotalDurationModel with a duration in seconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the total duration into an associative array with hours, minutes, and a formatted label.
